Before cleaning, record the bearing's initial appearance and the amount and condition of residual lubricant, and sample the lubricant before any cleaning is performed [EV-K01-009]. For lubricant sampling, keep used lubricant samples from bearings, housing and seal areas separately packaged and properly labelled, secure a sample of new unused lubricant, record any available specification or batch information from its container, and obtain technical specifications and any related material safety documentation to accompany lubricant shipments [EV-K01-006]. After thorough cleaning, inspection directions cover raceways and external surfaces, cage wear, increased internal clearance, degraded tolerances and other damage or abnormalities; reuse assessment also considers degree of wear, machine function, bearing importance, operating conditions and time until next inspection, but this is not a complete reuse/replacement rule [EV-K01-010]. The resulting observations are not already available in this demonstration: the caller-assigned class 'outer_race' and the assumed cause 'external_vibration_during_standstill' are teaching assumptions, not observations or classifier inferences, and actual device records are not supplied. An approved cleaning procedure for this unidentified equipment is also not available: the evidence registers only the evidence-preservation order (record appearance/residual lubricant, sample before cleaning) and does not authorize the source page's solvents or cleaning actions for an unknown machine [EV-K01-009]. No sample quantity, container model, product selection or laboratory acceptance threshold is supplied [EV-K01-006], and no model-specific thresholds or aviation/reuse authorization are in scope [EV-K01-010].

Evidence limitations:
Scope is registered generic bearing education only; no model-specific or aviation/reuse authorization, and no transfer validation to CWRU artificial defects or aviation equipment.
The 'outer_race' class and the assumed cause 'external_vibration_during_standstill' are independently specified teaching assumptions, not observations, source-proven sample facts, or classifier/task-model inferences.
Actual device records, lubricant container identity/specification/batch, sampling quantity, model-specific thresholds and aviation/reuse authorization are not supplied; missing information must not be fabricated (a project epistemic rule, not a quoted manufacturer procedure).
EV-K01-006 supplies no sample quantity, container model, product selection or laboratory acceptance threshold; specification OR batch is inclusive, not an unconditional dual requirement.
EV-K01-009 registers evidence-preservation order only and does not authorize the page's solvents or cleaning actions for an unknown machine; no approved cleaning procedure for this unidentified equipment is provided.
EV-K01-010 is not a complete reuse or rejection rule; hand rotation applies only to small nonseparable ball bearings, and reuse/replacement/release decisions require the full source rejection clauses and applicable equipment/OEM documents.
